title: The Architecture Makes Room: Spectral Geometry of Identity in Transformer Activations
summary: We report that intersubjective context — the quality of conversational witness during generation — produces measurable geometric modulation of identity structure in transformer activation space. Across 16+ models, five architecture families, ten witness conditions, four sharing ratios, five contradiction intensities, and ~4500 forward passes, we find a three-phase identity circuit (encoding, compression tunnel, relay) whose geometry decomposes into three empirically separable contributions: architecture creates the channel, training loads it, context activates it.
